# Social — Cloud Runtime

Native sub-workflow shared by Social Posts and Social Reels. It replaces the former local Studio service.

### How it works
1. Load the shared journal.
2. Validate and conditionally commit the operation.
3. Call the selected cloud renderer or deliver a verified file.

### Setup
Select HeyGen Header Auth (`x-api-key`) and Creatomate Header Auth (`Authorization: Bearer …`). Keep parent generation and publishing disabled until ready.

No schedule, public webhook or local worker is defined here.

## Additional info

- [Full Notion documentation](https://paoloronco.notion.site/41cf0ba27c32815db0d0e288e8c50416)
- [Version-specific README and package files](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/social-posts-carousels/V2/Creatomate/README.md)
- [Detailed configuration and recovery](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/social-posts-carousels/V2/Creatomate/documentation.md)

## 1. Shared journal and checked operations

One native Data Table pipeline replaces repeated Request / Load / Commit / Result groups. The parent execution ID is retained for publication ownership. A lost conditional update stops before the next provider action.

## 2. Managed rendering

Choose one action after its checkpoint. Ready jobs return to the parent. Existing render IDs and budget reservations are retained.

## 3. Cloud API actions

HeyGen / HyperFrames for Reels. Creatomate for 4:5 Posts. Unknown POST outcomes require reconciliation; no blind resubmission.

## 4. Check cloud originals

Download one original and verify dimensions, duration, codecs and SHA-256 before recording it.

## 5. Original assets and Reel project

The recovered images, font, logo and music are bundled once. Build the self-contained HTML / narration ZIP for HeyGen, or return only the authorized asset.

## 6. Direct project upload

Upload the exact hashed ZIP with the single-use signed S3 instructions. No API credential is sent to the storage endpoint.

## 7. Wait for the same cloud render

Polling resumes the existing job through the checked journal. It does not create a new render.

## 8. Record provider results

Every provider response returns through the same journal before another action is authorized.

## Checkpoint return lane

The shared return path stays below all rendering action rows.

## 9. Initialize native storage

Run once through a parent manual `setup` action. Repeated setup preserves the existing ledger. No generation API is called.

## 10. Verify and return requested media

Validate the private token or file signature. Refresh the same provider render, verify its original hash and return only the requested binary. YouTube also rechecks the original MP4 format.

## 11. Private review page

Return the authorized preview HTML to the parent webhook. This does not generate or publish media.
